default_preprocessing.sdc: fieldmap-less SyN (--use-syn-sdc error), as in completed pilot; no acquired fieldmap
default_preprocessing.limitation: Mask gains are not recovered acquisition support or evidence of universal registration superiority.
default_preprocessing.legacy_runner: Existing run_pilot.sh and protocol_v1.json remain historical AFNI artifacts; do not use them for this new default.
default_preprocessing.downstream_adapter: NOT IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED for fMRIPrep: preserve PSC/full-run 28-column nuisance intent; explicitly map radians motion, derivatives, WM/CSF masks before any future extraction. Do not substitute aCompCor or assume preproc BOLD is denoised.

atlas.name: Schaefer2018 100 parcels 7 networks
atlas.not_used: Schaefer FSLMNI152 (= MNI152NLin6Asym) files in ~/nilearn_data; different template space

primary_exclusions.subject: sub-080
primary_exclusions.reason: n-back events 285 rows (expected 294; 9 rows short inside blocks)

task.name: nbk
task.condition_of_row: prefix of trial_type before the first underscore

regressors: motion 6 (dfile_rall: roll, pitch, yaw, dS, dL, dP)
nuisance_intent_preserved_not_executed.fit: ordinary least squares over the full run (266 volumes) per subject; offline analysis that uses future time points

roi_scope.interpretation: All 100 parcels are specified model inputs; a narrower scientific essential set and partial-support acceptance rule are not defined.

windows.time_origin: first stored volume at t=0; events unchanged; fMRIPrep --slice-time-ref 0; dummy scans 0
windows.B: first recorded onset of the condition
windows.window_rule: [s0 + 30k, s0 + 30(k+1)), k = 0..3; must satisfy s0 + 120 <= E - end_buffer
windows.volume_index_rule: first volume index = s0 / 2 + 15k; 15 consecutive volumes

features_spec_not_executed.fc: Pearson over the 15 frames, upper triangle 4,950, clip +-(1-1e-6), Fisher z; window demeaning only inside FC

model_spec_not_executed.scaler: per-feature mean/SD fitted on the training fold only; zero-variance training features dropped with the same mask applied to validation/test
model_spec_not_executed.convergence_failures: counted and reported per fold; not silently retried

evaluation_spec_not_executed.outer: 6 folds, leave-one-order-out: all persons, conditions, windows of one order held out
evaluation_spec_not_executed.inner: 5 folds, leave-one-order-out within the outer-training orders
evaluation_spec_not_executed.inner_score: per-person 3-block accuracy, averaged within order, orders equally weighted
evaluation_spec_not_executed.C_selection: max inner score; ties within 1e-12 -> smaller C
evaluation_spec_not_executed.refit: final C refit on all outer-training persons; test predicted once
evaluation_spec_not_executed.sample_weight: w(window) proportional to 1 / (n_order x 3 x m_person_condition); orders, persons within order, conditions within person, windows within condition equal
evaluation_spec_not_executed.aggregation: mean window probabilities within the condition block, argmax; ties broken 0 -> 1 -> 2
evaluation_spec_not_executed.secondary_window_metric: window-level accuracy averaged within person first
evaluation_spec_not_executed.primary_endpoint: per-person proportion of the 3 blocks correct (= macro recall)
evaluation_spec_not_executed.primary_estimand: Delta = fullTS - FC: mean over the 6 orders (equal weight) of within-order person means, paired by person
evaluation_spec_not_executed.ci: stratified (within order) paired person bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261017, percentile 95%
evaluation_spec_not_executed.delta_note: absolute accuracy 0.02; operational design threshold, not a clinically or cognitively validated threshold
evaluation_spec_not_executed.single_primary_comparison: fullTS - FC; mean and mean+SD baselines descriptive only
evaluation_spec_not_executed.position_confound_note: leave-one-order-out reduces but does not remove block-position effects; no claim of order-invariant load or stimulus generalisation

qc.fd_definition: Power FD, 50 mm; fMRIPrep trans mm / rot radians; summaries over 1..265 (first difference omitted)
qc.coverage_definition: Atlas ROI fraction inside functional brain mask; acquired FOV is measured separately with all-volume transformed acquisition-grid support.
qc.fov_action: hold pending essential ROI and partial-support decision; 0.90 is a carried-forward diagnostic flag, not a new exclusion threshold
qc.signal: Mask omission alone does not establish signal dropout. Check ROI signal, finite/nonzero variance and spatial correspondence before final inclusion.
qc.Q1_inputs: T1w and n-back present and readable; sha256 equals download verification; TR 2 s; 266 volumes; events with 3 complete conditions (98 rows each); sub-080 excluded (R1)
qc.Q6_nuisance_masks: eroded WM and CSF masks non-empty and their series finite with variance > 0; voxel counts reported
Q7_descriptive_only: DVARS (RMS of backward-difference voxel PSC inside full_mask)
tSNR (mean / SD after linear detrend, median in full_mask and per ROI)
volume-0 to run-median global intensity ratio
Q4_visual_checklist: no left-right flip on anatomical review; AFNI check_flip is historical, not an fMRIPrep gate
T1 outline, ventricles and major sulci without gross template mismatch
EPI brain edge and ventricles without gross shift; local susceptibility effects separately documented
EPI slab truncation assessed with separate acquired support
qc.registration: Gross mismatch requires review; correlations and Dice are descriptive, no new cutoffs.
qc.review_completion: Not yet established for final analysis inclusion; selected slices are not exhaustive expert QC.
qc.stop_rule: before training: stop and review if any order has n < 10 or more than 20% of the 157 candidates are excluded

reasons: fMRIPrep downstream extraction adapter not validated
no full-cohort or training execution authorization
